startup_optimization.geometry_ablation_decision: Reverted: no repeatable CPU benefit from removing temporary fixed-pose factor arrays. No search/confirmation algorithm or acceptance threshold changed.
limitations: Search remains above half a core; startup improvements are separate from registration work
Native result timing varies with scheduling; exact-input core replays separately check unchanged decisions
A map subscriber still incurs one visualization build and storage; not eliminated by lazy startup
Atlas v3 requires this reader; keep v2 for older deployments
DDS profile is Fast DDS-specific; 64MiB per participant and 512MiB Docker capacity are measured settings, not universal sizing
No full raw-sensor frontend+backend concurrent load or six-real-sequence ARM qualification in this stage
harness_corrections: Pilot containers had only64MiB /dev/shm and reported SHM initialization fallback; excluded and rerun with512MiB
Old x86 replay executable used pre-extension core layout and crashed; rebuilt against current headers before all accepted comparisons
Noetic old CTest ignores --test-dir; rerun from actual build directory and confirm67tests executed
notes: The post-test Docker build container uses its default64MiB /dev/shm and launches no DDS participant; benchmark containers use512MiB as recorded in their commands.
The explicit DDS profile and default launch tests are local-only qualification; no claim of multi-host discovery.
